rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for ordinary support or approval, including a public figure's backing when it is simply described as support.

example.english: The singer's endorsement of this charity event made everyone feel more confident.
example.traditional: 今次個慈善活動有歌手公開支持，令大家更加放心。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 ci4 sin6 wut6 dung6 jau5 go1 sau2 gung1 hoi1 zi1 ci4 ling6 daai6 gaa1 gang3 gaa1 fong3 sam1

rows.note: Use this when an influential or well-known person publicly lends authority or credibility to someone or something.

example.english: This famous actor's endorsement of the brand immediately made more people trust the product.
example.traditional: 呢位影帝親自為呢個品牌背書，產品即刻多人信。
example.jyutping: nei1 wai6 jing2 dai3 can1 zi6 wai6 nei1 go3 ban2 paai4 bui6 syu1 caan2 ban2 zik1 hak1 do1 jan4 seon3

rows.note: Use this for an amendment or annotation recorded on an insurance policy, licence, or other official document.

example.english: The insurance company added an endorsement to the policy, expanding the coverage.
example.traditional: 保險公司喺保單上加咗一項批註，保障範圍闊咗。
